overview.text: Brett Haddoak is a software engineer and small business owner. His company, Oakworks Software, builds software for public schools. He supports mixed-use development and a variety of housing types, including apartments, condos, and single-family homes. He proposes requiring recycled water for outdoor irrigation in new construction where infrastructure exists. He wants to bring a full-service hospital to Santa Clarita. His campaign says he has volunteered over 1,000 hours at the Bridge to Home homeless shelter, served on the city’s Homelessness Task Force, and built the software for the city’s Shared Housing pilot program.
